page.layout: One printed page, one text column. Running head at top centre. Headings and paragraphs in the column. Marginal references at the left edge, a few small marks at the right edge. Below the text, a small catchword-like mark at the right: "j.q.j" (signature-style reference).

main_text.head: De his qui per munera invadunt ecclesias vacantes. Ex Concilio Rothomagensi.
main_text.p: 7.q 1.Sancitum est.) Sancitum est, atque omnibus modis prohibitum, ut si quis presbyter inuentus fuerit alicui clerico vel laico munera dare vel dedisse, aut aliam pecuniam tribuere, ut alterius presbyteri ecclesiam vacantem pretio redimat, pro hac cupiditate, seu rapina, seu praesumptione, turpis lucri gratia, deijciatur à clero, & alienus exiftat à regula.

head.i: Simoniacos non esse sacerdotes, ideoq; deponi debere.

main_text.p: 1.q.1.Quicunq;.) Quicunq; sacros ordines vendunt aut emunt, sacerdotes esse non possunt.
Item. Gregor. Quicunque studet per pretij datonem sacrum ordinem accipere, sacerdos non est, sed inaniter tantummodo dici concupiscit.

Idem in Registro. Presbyter si per pecuniam ecclesias obtinuerit, non solum ecclesia priuetur, sed etiam sacerdotij honore spolietur, quia & altare & decimas & Spiritum sanctum emere vel vendere, Simoniacam haeresim esse nullus fidelium ignorat.

head.i: Simoniacos habere et dare Spiritum mendacij. Leo Papa.

page.notes: Old-spelling sections: the "s" long s has been rendered as plain s throughout. Marginal references at the left ("7.q 1.", "1.q.1.") and at the bottom right ("j.q.j") are the printed reference marks; the left-hand ones are placed where they stand. The heading "Simoniacos non esse sacerdotes, ideoq; deponi debere." is set in italic and treated as a level-2 heading; "Simoniacos habere et dare Spiritum mendacij. Leo Papa." is treated as a level-3 heading. Some letters near the right edge and the marks below "Leo Papa." are faint and uncertain; the bottom-right "j.q.j" reference was read as printed but may be imprecise. Word "Quicunq;" in the marginal reference is italic/underlined in print; the sentence "Quicunq; sacros ordines" carries "vendunt aut emunt" as printed. The word "datonem" is printed as shown and may be "donationem" in a blurred print; left as read. The word "sacerdotij" was read from a blurred line and is uncertain.
